resolved_findings.trigger: Interruption inside compressed NPZ writing before a per-method final forecast has finished saving
resolved_findings.before: The inherited saver wrote directly to canonical V.npz with open('xb'). A truncated canonical file would then be opened by np.load on resume, preventing normal replay.
resolved_findings.after: The new evaluator writes a numbered private attempt path and atomically replaces canonical V.npz only after saving succeeds. Earlier interrupted attempt files remain preserved. Complete canonical files are validated by the inherited saver.

open_nonblocking_findings.required_public_interpretation: Report this aggregate legacy calls field as N/A or null with reason attribute absent. Preserve the original private result and frozen scientific source. Never claim no F calls from that zero.

contract_trace_checks.contract: Mandatory matched B matrix and extension
contract_trace_checks.evidence: Four methods times two seeds per dataset; cap extension operates on the complete corresponding group, not only a favorable seed.

B selected epochs come from M_select results. C gate uses both F seeds against G and full-precision two-seed means against fixed alpha/Q/raw/readout alternatives. No V loader occurs in train_B or finish_training.

contract_trace_checks.contract: All C decisions before new V
contract_trace_checks.evidence: finish_training verifies complete required B refits and every admitted C method/seed before SEALED_BEFORE_V; evaluate checks this seal before inherited full-V prefix loading.

B worker binds models/engine/data-contract sources, exact G/S artifact/scaler and F identity; C registers blocks/c_stage/models/engine. Worker checks original parent hashes and F invariance after training, and C explicitly checks original A60 P/center.

Probe residuals are FP32 Y-G before FP64 fitting, unobserved targets are excluded by original bool masks, fitting feature statistics use M_fit, final statistics use full Mcal. Ridge normal equations add lambda times channel-total observed count across origins and horizons; intercept is unpenalized; no explicit matrix inverse. Exact lambda tie selects larger lambda.

Existing fit_alpha_diagnostic supplies M_fit selection coefficients separately from full-Mcal refit coefficients. Evaluator retains alpha 0,0.5,1 and fitted without a new per-channel or per-horizon grid.

contract_trace_checks.contract: Future data excluded from inference path
contract_trace_checks.evidence: Model corrections receive only historical normalized x and the foundation callable. Actual deployment receives physical history plus its past bool mask. Targets/masks are loss/scoring inputs, not latent/F forecasting inputs. Original target_window fills unobserved target storage with normalized zero while preserving the false mask.

Diagnostic covariance uses filled past histories and explicitly labels overlapping histories; channel/horizon/time-block scores retain the original target mask. No V loader exists in diagnostics/probes.
